races.name: CopyBet And Worcester Here All Year Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Feet On The Ground
runners_data.comment: Modest hurdler but a pointing background bodes well for this switch to fences
runners_data.spotlight: No threat to easy winner Beorma when third of five on chasing debut here (2m, good) two weeks ago but that run was still quite encouraging, and she might be better suited by this longer trip; won't mind if the ground softens; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Wings On Wheels
runners_data.comment: Still unexposed under rules but needs improvement over this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Still unexposed under rules and was seemingly aided by new cheekpieces when second of four at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in March; that form isn't anything to get excited about, though, and he was well held when third at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) last month; now tries a visor; forecast rain probably not ideal.

runners_data.name: Best Mate Dave
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far when last of four in Warwick hunter chase (3m, good) last month but managed only fifth of seven in a subsequent point; back in a handicap chase for stable debut; quite tricky to weigh up at the moment; seems best suited by good ground.

runners_data.name: Dynamite Defense
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m on the Flat in Ireland in 2024; no joy since and makes debut for new yard.
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two low-grade AW handicaps for Olly Murphy in February/March but was last of six when back over hurdles here (2m, good) for new stable last month and is not bred for chasing.

runners_data.name: Les's Destiny Star
runners_data.comment: Had wind surgery prior to resurgent effort over C&D last time; respected off same mark
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner; 0-6 over hurdles and needs to bounce back from a poor run but his third of 14 at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) in April was a good effort; drops back in trip and sports first-time cheekpieces on chasing debut; could have a say if back on song.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.comment: Fast-improving mare who has collected three easy wins in the last 12 days
runners_data.spotlight: Fast-improving mare who has been on the rampage over the last fortnight, winning two 2m chases and two hurdles (2m4f/2m) on good ground; carries 7lb penalty for Tuesday's success over fences at Southwell but did that pretty easily; obvious contender, providing she's not derailed by significant rain.

runners_data.name: Rockvale
runners_data.comment: Yet to make the frame in six starts under rules, sixth at Bangor last month
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 under all codes but was clear second to a next-time-out winner over fences at Uttoxeter (2m5f, good) last month and has each-way claims at least off same mark here; placed in Irish points on soft ground.

runners_data.name: Miss Pearl
runners_data.comment: She finished well behind over hurdles last week after a layoff
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden after 16 runs but hasn't been with current stable long and wasn't beaten far when fourth of six on chasing debut at Ffos Las (3m, good to soft) three weeks ago; may benefit from this drop back in trip and has the services of Sean Bowen; worth a second look.

runners_data.name: Emberscombe
runners_data.spotlight: Won two four-runner points this spring but has poor record under rules (0-14) and makes only limited appeal here.

runners_data.name: Kings Order
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced all six hurdle runs, most recently when beaten about 28l in Chepstow handicap (2m, good to soft) in March, but his Irish point second last spring offers a ray of hope on this chasing debut.

races.name: CopyBet Proudly Backs UK Horse Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Excello
runners_data.spotlight: Now 4lb lower than when creditable third of 17 over the big Aintree fences (2m5f, good to soft) in November but his subsequent form has been underwhelming; drops in grade here but still needs to up his game and has presumably been overlooked by Nico de Boinville; seems versatile ground-wise.

runners_data.name: Ideal Des Bordes
runners_data.spotlight: Had very mixed record in 2025 but was creditable second at Newbury (3m2f, good; second run in blinkers) on latest outing in December and has strong claims if in similar form here; well suited by good to soft ground and was a point winner on yielding to soft.

runners_data.name: Samuel Spade
runners_data.comment: Quiet last season but too well handicapped to dismiss on chasing debut
runners_data.spotlight: Lacked fluency and was ultimately well beaten over C&D (good) on chasing debut a fortnight ago, after a layoff, but significant positives can still be drawn from that performance and he ought to cope better than some of these if the ground softens; can be dangerous if in a better rhythm today.

runners_data.name: Peaky Boy
runners_data.comment: Below form during light campaign last season but not written off just yet
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointing for new stable last season but appreciated the ease in grade when respectable third of six in quite valuable contest at Uttoxeter (3m, good) last month and won't mind what the weather does here; contender if able to build on that recent effort.

runners_data.name: Stumps Or Slips
runners_data.comment: Proved stamina for 3m with ease at Exeter latest (good) and still on the up; big player.
runners_data.spotlight: In excellent form in hunter chases in April, winning twice in good style on good ground (3m/2m7f); can't be ruled out after those exploits but faces tougher assignment on this handicap return and probably won't be favoured by the forecast rain.

runners_data.name: Disco Davis
runners_data.comment: 2m hurdle winner; changed hands for 1,000gns after selling hurdle defeat; watching brief.
runners_data.spotlight: Very inconsistent for Dan Skelton last season but ran well from the front when third here (2m4f, good) on stable debut three weeks ago and won't mind if the ground is much slower today (has won on heavy); unexposed over this sort of trip; a possible if in the right mood again.

runners_data.name: Presentandcounting
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground specialist with nine chase wins on his CV; returned from break with two respectable runs this spring and has edged his way back down to a good mark but the forecast rain is the obvious worry.

runners_data.name: Grand Clermont
runners_data.comment: Ex-French where all his winning was on heavy ground; tailed off on British debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won seven chases (most on heavy ground) when based in France and came good for David Pipe at the second attempt, with wide-margin success at Uttoxeter (3m, good) last month; up 10lb in higher-grade race here but still commands respect.

runners_data.name: My Bobby Dazzler
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season in good form, winning at Hereford (3m1f, soft) before good second at Haydock (3m1f, good), and ran quite a bit better than eventual 20l defeat suggests when fourth in Cartmel marathon (3m5f, good) last month; no surprise if he features here.

runners_data.name: Bagheera Ginge
runners_data.comment: Off since poor run in October and still on fairly tough mark; headgear switched
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who returned from seven-month break with 7l win in first-time visor at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) last month; only 4lb higher here but the market principals in that race disappointed and the form is of questionable value; raced mainly on good ground but has won on good to soft and been placed on soft.

races.name: CopyBet Royal Ascot Bog From Sunday Mares' NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateurs) Cat 1 Elim) (GBB)

runners_data.name: Dora's Double
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam point winner, out of unraced half-sister to Midlands Grand National winner Russian Trigger; stable has healthy strike-rate in bumpers (12%); market may guide.

runners_data.name: Evenly
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam maiden pointer/well beaten in bumper, half-sister to useful jumper Bobs Law; stable does pretty well in bumpers (12% strike-rate); a possible.

runners_data.name: Honour Me
runners_data.spotlight: £1,000 3yo; ninth foal; half-sister to winners Persian Time (useful hurdle/chase), Restandbethankful (bumper/jumps), Thermusa (hurdle) and Little Jack (bumper); dam maiden; with a good stable; plausible contender.

runners_data.name: Lady Of Tarsus
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal from unraced sister to high-class bumper/hurdle winner Kilcooley; beaten before unseating rider at penultimate fence in heavy-ground Irish point in February; may fare better in this different contest.

runners_data.name: Maximore
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in two points this year but represents astute Irish stable and is worth a glance in the betting before this rules debut; hood fitted.

runners_data.name: Crack Of Thunder
runners_data.spotlight: 23,000gns yearling; second foal; half-sister to a fair sprinter; dam well-connected 6f winner; not an obvious type for bumpers but represents good Flat stable and has presumably inherited stamina from his sire.

runners_data.name: Eagles Promise
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; dam fair 2m hurdle winner, sister to smart bumper/jumps winner Super Duty and useful jumper Grandads Cottage; one of two newcomers in this field for Tom George (4-22 in bumpers in last five seasons).

runners_data.name: Lucy Glitters
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to a point winner; dam bumper/2m5f hurdle winner, half-sister to bumper and 2m6f/3m hurdle winner Smart Mover; one of two newcomers from this stable; wears a hood.

runners_data.name: Matilda Maid
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to two point winners; dam unplaced in bumpers, half-sister to stable's Cheltenham Gold Cup winner Coneygree and high-class jumper Carruthers; might be a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Pearl Cove
runners_data.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to low-grade chase winner Eightytwo Team; dam useful hurdler/chaser, half-sister to Flat winner/useful hurdler Dangerously Good; rare bumper runner for the stable.

runners_data.name: Poppieholla
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; sister to 2m3f hurdle winner Briefly, half-sister to 2m hurdle winner Sammy's Guarantee; dam bumper winner/placed 2m6f hurdle, half-sister to useful bumper/jumps winner Thomas Brown; makes some appeal on pedigree but stable not prolific in bumpers.

runners_data.name: Queens Glance
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam low-grade 2m Flat winner, half-sister to stable's fair hurdler I'm A Starman; wears a tongue-tie; other newcomers look more interesting on paper.

runners_data.name: Tottie's Moon
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unplaced in bumper/over hurdles, sister to useful jumper Mac Tottie; wears a tongue-tie; stable does well in bumpers.

runners_data.name: Pearl Knot
runners_data.comment: Yard 21% in bumpers in recent years and she needs watching in market on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister to low-grade chase winner Pearl Island; dam 2m6f-3m hurdle winner, sister to 3m-3m5f chase winner Bretney, closely related to useful 2m4f-4m hurdle/chase winner Captain Cattistock; has stout pedigree but stable does well in bumpers (21% strike-rate).

runners_data.name: Unflappable
runners_data.comment: £4,500 3yo; third foal; half-sister to 2m-2m1f chase winner Pure Carbon
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to fairly useful chaser Pure Carbon; made promising debut when clear third of ten under positive ride at Newton Abbot (good) last month and ought to put that experience to good use here.

runners_data.name: Liberty Leader
runners_data.comment: Has fair target to aim at on debut and is best watched unless market suggests otherwise
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to smart jumper Libberty Hunter but showed only minor promise when fifth of nine at Bangor (good) last month and needs to take a big step forward here.

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Maiden Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Luckonthemoor
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam 1m4f AW winner (RPR 76), half-sister to useful jumper Smarty Wild; probably best watched on belated debut.

runners_data.name: Lucky Diamond
runners_data.comment: Sufficient promise in his second bumper run to believe he'll have a role to play
runners_data.spotlight: Blotted copybook when veering right and unseating rider soon after the start of a recent bumper but the form of his third here last October (good ground) has worked out quite well; could have a say if all goes to plan on hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Premier Tenor
runners_data.comment: Dam French 2m1f hurdle winner; French 13.5f Flat winner; interesting on stable debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Made winning debut on the Flat in France last October (good to soft); unable to justify favouritism when third (just behind Shamsat) over C&D (good; first-time hood/tongue-tie) three weeks ago but that still goes down as a promising stable/hurdle debut, and he has obvious scope for progress.

runners_data.name: Babs
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper on debut in October but she's not gone on from that; needs improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Doesn't help herself by tending to race too freely but won good-ground Stratford bumper in the autumn and ran big race in defeat over hurdles at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) a fortnight ago; should cope if the ground eases; can make her presence felt.

runners_data.name: Drombeg Lad
runners_data.spotlight: Went close in good-ground course bumper a year ago and was placed on both hurdling starts last summer, the latter over C&D; has fitness to prove after 284-day absence and ground slower than good would be new to him but he still enters each-way calculations.

runners_data.name: Shamsat
runners_data.spotlight: Won on the Flat in France last year (heavy ground) and has been placed on both British hurdling starts, more recently when second of ten in similar race to this over C&D three weeks ago; likely contender again.

runners_data.name: Trouville
runners_data.spotlight: Useful Flat racer who was placed in Class 3 AW handicap (2m; RPR 89) on latest outing last summer; changed hands for 13,000gns in the autumn; has form on good and soft ground; will be dangerous at this level if he takes adequately to hurdling at the first attempt.

runners_data.name: Hollysaway
runners_data.comment: 200-1 when tailed off in a novice hurdle for mares at Chepstow in March
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at big odds on both hurdling starts (2m/2m1f); needs subsequent wind op to have made a massive difference.

runners_data.name: Amalfina
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 on the Flat for Karl Burke but showed some fair form at up to 1m5f and seems versatile ground-wise; sold for 7,000gns in the autumn; makes stable/hurdle debut after eight-month break.

runners_data.name: Nightflyer
runners_data.comment: Only fourth at Warwick 16 days ago and has much more on his plate here
runners_data.spotlight: Won soft-ground Catterick bumper for Adrian Keatley on debut in January; ran well in only one of three subsequent bumpers for current stable but faced tough task in Aintree festival Grade 2 on latest occasion; should have a future over hurdles and won't mind the forecast rain.

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Maiden Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Mystic Wind
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam placed 1m3f AQPS Flat/well held only hurdles start, closely related to a French 2m3f chase winner, half-sister to to two French AQPS Flat winners; represents a top stable but it's unnerving to see a hood fitted on debut.

runners_data.name: Fiskardo
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner last month but others in here did have superior form in that scene
runners_data.spotlight: Led on post to win good-ground Perth bumper in April, after a long layoff, and wasn't discredited when well-held second over hurdles at Ffos Las (2m, good to soft; winner had useful bumper form) last month; probably won't be far away.

runners_data.name: Dancingondiamonds
runners_data.comment: Debut promise in May; gelded since and won't have to improve too much to play major role
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to build upon last spring's quite promising Irish Flat debut when unplaced odds-on favourite in AW maiden in January but was given a wind op soon afterwards and has joined good stable for hurdling career.

runners_data.name: Bacardi Blue
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in Newton Abbot bumper last September and returns to racing under rules after well-held second in two-finisher point last month; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Minella Blizzard
runners_data.comment: Out of a well-connected mare but was pulled up on his Irish point debut in April
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a well-connected mare but was pulled up on Irish point debut in April and also struggled in a recent novice hurdle; wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Just Call Me Buzz
runners_data.comment: Stayed on into third in a Chepstow maiden on his hurdles debut last month
runners_data.spotlight: Well held when third on hurdling debut in April but displayed improvement and lost out only by a nose when second over C&D (good) three weeks ago; might encounter slower ground today but still a major player.

runners_data.name: Purple Owl
runners_data.comment: Tailed off/pulled up in two handicaps on either side of a wind op; capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form when placed twice in novice company towards end of 2025 (2m, good/soft) but well beaten in two 2m4f handicaps this year; drops back in trip here; needs to get career back on track.

runners_data.name: Kernie d'Airy
runners_data.comment: Second at Hereford (2m3f) on hurdle debut in March and can build on that effort here
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning slow-ground French bumper on debut in November 2024 but was second on hurdle debut at Hereford (2m3f, good) in March and might not have been suited by the idiosyncratic track when below that form at Fakenham (2m4f, good) last month; drops back in trip with tongue-tie added here; has a fighting chance.

runners_data.name: Angel Of My Dreams
runners_data.comment: Won a point bumper on debut but well beaten in both subsequent rules bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: Easily won a point bumper in March 2025 (good to soft) but did not show much in three rules bumpers (remote when second last month); significant improvement required on hurdle debut; tongue-tie removed.

races.name: CopyBet For Your Daily Profit Boost Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Sunray Shadow
runners_data.comment: Makes chase debut off the same mark he defied comfortably last week over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo is thriving of late and he readily followed up his hurdling success at Huntingdon (3m1f, good to firm) in 2m7f handicap chase here (good) two weeks ago; up 8lb but still looks the one to beat back hurdling.

runners_data.name: American Mike
runners_data.comment: His fourth run for current yard when forcing a dead-heat at Perth (3m, good; 3lb lower)
runners_data.spotlight: Very smart 3m-winning chaser for Gordon Elliott in 2024/25; also scored over fences for current yard at Perth (3m) in April but beat just one when tried in cheekpieces in 2m4f handicap chase at Uttoxeter 18 days ago; reverts to hurdles off a 7lb lower mark but still has something to prove.

runners_data.name: Shallow River
runners_data.comment: Won 3m h'cap hurdle at Carlisle in December 2024; not run since; looks stable's 2nd string
runners_data.spotlight: Took a step forward on just his second run for Olly Murphy when landing 3m1f handicap hurdle at Carlisle in October 2024; went without his usual cheekpieces after 17 months off when a never-dangerous sixth in 2m4f Hexham handicap last month; can strip sharper now with headgear refitted.

runners_data.name: Ballintubber Boy
runners_data.comment: Absent since two small-field seconds in October but is 3-3 over C&D; likely contender
runners_data.spotlight: Looked rusty after seven months off when last of seven in 3m1f handicap hurdle at Huntingdon 23 days ago; this fairly useful winning hurdler can take a step forward now.

runners_data.name: Gwennie May Boy
runners_data.comment: Won Grade 2 Rendlesham last February but hasn't matched that form before or since
runners_data.spotlight: A smart 3m-winning hurdler for Dan Skelton in 2024/25; only raced twice for Olly Murphy last season and not seen out since being pulled up in Long Walk Hurdle at Ascot in December; has it to prove starting out for another new yard here.

races.name: Step Into Luxury With Purple Granite Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Bobbarelli
runners_data.comment: Disappointed when beaten 20l over fences at Bangor last Saturday.
runners_data.spotlight: Dual point winner; still seeking first rules win (0-6); likes to race prominently, weakening on the run-in when last seen over hurdles at Taunton (2m3f, good) in April; went down fighting over fences at Stratford 12 days ago; player.

runners_data.name: Katana
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up over C&D on final start for Nicky Henderson last May, and again on first start for this trainer (6-4 favourite) the following month; badly out of sorts since and remains winless; handicap mark has plummeted accordingly; clear risks attached.

runners_data.name: Western Soldier
runners_data.comment: Not much has gone to plan since his quite stylish Wincanton win in November
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Wincanton (1m7f, good; from 2lb lower) last November, but lost his way and unseated in March; stayed on into modest fourth at Hexham (2m; beaten 12l) three weeks ago, though; slightly more needed.

runners_data.name: Son Of Hypnos
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Galway (2m, good) in July 2024; downhill thereafter, ending time in Ireland competing on the Flat; third of five at Exeter (2m; 33-1) on second start for this trainer but tough to fancy on strength of his other two efforts.

runners_data.name: Play Pretend
runners_data.comment: May have needed his reappearance run at Worcester and has claims if back near best
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner (three ran) last July and beaten a neck over 2m4f here (similar mark) last October; below par in two starts this year, lacking fluency when beaten 36l at Bangor (2m4f, good) latest; a possible on peak form.

runners_data.name: Emerald Time
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in bumpers and in his qualifying races; improvement possible in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in a Warwick bumper and glimpses of ability over hurdles, none more so than when falling two out at Ludlow (2m, soft) in February; lacked the pace to challenge on handicap debut at Aintree (2m1f, good) but still unexposed; tongue-tie added.

runners_data.name: Privilege
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came on the Flat at Tipperary (7.5f) in June 2021; twice runner-up at Newton Abbot (2m3f, good) this time last year; weakened quickly on latest start at Bath last August; isn't impossible, but reasons to oppose.

runners_data.name: Raffles Nobu
runners_data.comment: Sole win was in France in 2023 and he went out like a light at Uttoxeter three weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Won in France in 2023; struggled in three starts for Nicky Henderson and limited since joining this trainer; attracted market support but weakened from the second-last when third of five at Huntingdon (2m4f) 17 days ago; dropping back in trip is a sensible move.

runners_data.name: Belcamo
runners_data.spotlight: Broke his duck over jumps at Fakenham (2m, good to soft) in January; that wasn't a particularly strong contest and he has been absent since; now 3lb higher.

runners_data.name: Barafundle Bay
runners_data.comment: Low-grade Flat winner in 2024; beaten 22l and 39l in her two runs over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Won on the Flat (about 1m3f) in June 2024; well beaten all three starts over hurdles, including when jumping left on occasions at Ffos Las (2m4f; handicap debut) three weeks ago; now 3lb lower; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Strong As Steel
runners_data.comment: Best run was in a bumper and he's struggled to find a foothold over hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11; pulled up in three of his last five runs; returns from six-month break on just his third outing for trainer (also represented by Alex The Great); an easing mark aside, there aren't too many positives.

runners_data.name: Alex The Great
runners_data.comment: Beaten long way in two similar events over 2m at Hereford recently.
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time AW winner (1m6f-2m); well beaten in three spins over hurdles; lowly rated for handicap debut but he needs a spark; stablemate of Strong As Steel.

races.name: CopyBet For Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Belle Le Grand
runners_data.spotlight: Easily resumed winning ways at Newton Abbot (2m1f) in May and not discredited off a 7lb higher mark when sixth of ten in 2m1f handicap at Cartmel 19 days ago; not out of things back up in trip.

runners_data.name: October Hill
runners_data.comment: 0-11 under rules and has been beaten about 15l in her two handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Got back on the up with a breakthrough success in 2m4f handicap at Ffos Las 22 days ago; she must enter calculations back up 2lb.

runners_data.name: Janworth
runners_data.spotlight: Returned from an absence in fine form last summer when a two-time scorer, including over C&D; back from nine months off here with yard going very well so she merits serious consideration given her good record when fresh.

runners_data.name: Politacus
runners_data.comment: Nothing wrong with her mark if getting back in this discipline floats her boat
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since April 2024 and she came in a remote second of seven back hurdling in 2m Uttoxeter handicap 18 days ago; needs to take a step forward.

runners_data.name: Hello Cello
runners_data.spotlight: Placed twice over C&D last summer before gaining a breakthrough success in 2m3f handicap at Fontwell in October; lightly raced since but she posted a good third of 12 in 2m5f Warwick handicap last month so needs considering off the same mark.

runners_data.name: Kittys Glance
runners_data.comment: Won at Huntingdon in March and pedigree provides optimism that she will keep progressing
runners_data.spotlight: Underwent wind surgery before landing 2m4f maiden at Huntingdon (first-time hood) in March; not discredited under a 7lb penalty when second of five in 2m4f Hereford novice 30 days ago; she may do better still now going into handicaps with few miles on the clock.

runners_data.name: Portetta
runners_data.comment: Second in Tipperary maiden on decent ground last year; heavy didn't suit on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Returned from four months off with a below-par tenth in 2m1f handicap at Down Royal last month; plenty more is required if she's to gain a maiden victory here.

runners_data.name: Shesonnet
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark up in trip at Warwick 26 days ago on her handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a first victory on her handicap debut at Warwick (2m5f) in May but she beat only two in similar company at Stratford (2m6f) 12 days ago; she needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Kom Tu Voudras
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark on her stable debut in a Huntingdon maiden in February.
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced ex-Irish hurdler who made a winning start for Faye Bramley in 2m4f Huntingdon maiden in February; built on that with an excellent second of seven on handicap debut at Warwick (2m5f) last month; winner has gone in again so she's a player off an unchanged mark; cheekpieces  added.

runners_data.name: All Inn Hand
runners_data.comment: Hurdle/chase winner last spring; returned with lacklustre chase run last month
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at up to 3m over hurdles at Stratford and fences at Hexham early last summer; well below par both runs this spring after 11 months off, though, pulled up in 3m2f hurdle at Stratford in May; has it to prove now.
